text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And so, y'know! Listen! 
............Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
That ritual at the museum really is 
different from Soaring Gallop after all, 
right?! 
There's no way humans aren't needed, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...That depicts the ancient form of 
Soaring Gallop.

As the spring GⅠ season rolls on, 
the Umamusume are buzzing with race 
chatter.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
The Tokyo Yushun is already coming up this 
year~! 
Man, must be nice... It's the ultimate 
dream~!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I'm stuck in an Open class 
race. 
Still, I promised my Trainer I'd give it 
my all. 
...—Ah.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
No Reason-chan! 
Do you have a second to chat?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou art welcome. 
Shall steamed buns and piping-hot tea 
accompany our discourse~?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it won't take that long. 
I just wanted to ask about the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Is it too late for me to take part? 
...Even as a volunteer or something, 
anything's fine.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Oho?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
I wanna hear about this too! 
I've got a bond with my Trainer too, you 
know!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
If it's a festival for humans and 
Umamusume, I'd love to help out!!

On this day, everyone had planned 
to gather together after training.

As the Umamusume trickled 
onto the course one by one—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Why's the mood so heaavyyy?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: M-Maya-cha...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, hold on!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Why are you wearing such a gloomy 
face too, Scarlet-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ugh, well.........

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm pretty much the reason 
Blast got so down in the dumps in the 
first place.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, my Yabusame 
...might be the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yabusame is? The same as Soaring Gallop?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because it makes no sense. 
The Goshiki Shuntaisai is supposed to be 
a festival honoring the bond between 
humans and Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet the only time humans get involved in 
Yabusame 
is after the program is already finished— 
just handing out the targets and arrows we 
hit—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—and the regular Shuntaisai Yabusame 
didn't even include that step to begin 
with.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I just don't get it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Both Blast and I want to believe 
these rituals are meant for Umamusume and 
humans. 
But if the festival can exist without 
humans at all—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Then what's the point of having humans 
around?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What does that person working so hard 
beside us 
even mean to us—...what?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why are we even holding a festival 
for humans... and Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, one and all! 
We have a dire crisis upon our hands~~!

Hearing the shout, the girls and I rushed 
over. 
Standing there were No Reason and...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Are you all right, No Reason-san? 
I've got some tea for you, too~.

...Wonder Acute. 
A delightfully laid-back, granny-like 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! First, everyone, 
partake of these black beans 
that Lady Acute prepared for us!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, black beans! 
They're sweet and so yummy, right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, but why are they salty~~?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-what?!  
She's right! They're salty as heck!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...They are quite salty. 
Completely different from the ones we eat 
at New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. 
I made them using an ancient recipe, you 
see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Way, way back in the day, 
black beans were simmered in soy sauce, 
apparently.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The kind everyone knows, 
simmered with sugar, came along much 
later. 
Hehehe, quite a surprise, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was mighty surprised myself 
when Miss No Reason 
taught me the recipe.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Thus, black beans are meant to be 
savory! 
This is the true, orthodox black bean!
choice_data_list:
The traditional, orthodox one... so 
then...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
——Or so 
didst thou think I would say, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nay, 'tis quite simple. 
I far prefer the sugar-simmered kind!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Which is to say, the modern, evolved form 
possessed ample value to warrant such 
change.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...Tell me, Lady Blast.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Thou didst say it thyself: 
that thou preferred racing alongside 
humans.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know not how it was done of old. 
Yet didst thou not discover the worth of 
running with humans 
through thine own training alongside thy 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! 
And that pertains directly to the “reason” 
behind change!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! So long as a tradition alters its 
form 
and endures into the modern era—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Doth it not stand to reason that the 
change itself held value? 
That there was a profound reason for it to 
change?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, all things 
evolve to match the shifting tides of 
time.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Even the “Sacred Flag Competition” in 
which I partake 
is a new ritual established barely a 
hundred-odd years ago!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!  
Then the Sacred Flag Competition is—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not from the dawn of the Soma Nomaoi. 
Not every aspect has remained as it was 
in days of yore.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the Soma Nomaoi was a samurai 
ritual. 
In the beginning, it was not a “festival 
of humans and horsegirls” 
as it is today!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Why?!  
Why did the Soma Nomaoi change?!
choice_data_list:
Since when, and why, did the festival 
change?

Since when, and why, did the festival 
change?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! Look at thee, one and all! 
Dost thou all share the very same trouble?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why did the Soma Nomaoi transform? 
...Dost thou truly wish to uncover the 
reason behind it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Maya wants to know too! 
Right, Yuki-ppe?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I want to know too! 
I want to understand everyone's sacred 
rites!!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Very well! 
Then let us unravel the mystery together!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Why did the Soma Nomaoi assume its present 
form? 
What manner of origin and purpose lies 
beneath?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As fortune would have it, 
the Soma Nomaoi begins in late May. 
—Shall we embark upon a delightful study 
together?

Hearing No Reason's words, 
I reach for my smartphone.

First, to contact the Soma Nomaoi 
Executive Committee. 
—So that we may discover for ourselves 
the “reasons” No Reason spoke of.
